headerDisplay: Homebridge accessory for Philips TVs with the JointSpace API enabled, including Ambilight and Ambilight+Hue support.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/rafaelgaspar/homebridge-philipstv-hue-2020#readme) for details on pairing 2016+ Android TV models and finding your TV's Wake-on-LAN URL.

ip_address.title: IP Address
ip_address.description: The local IP address of the TV.

model_year.title: Model Year
model_year.description: Used to pick the correct JointSpace API version (>=2016 uses API v6 with digest authentication, 2014-2015 uses API v5, older uses API v1).

has_ssl.title: Uses HTTPS (port 1926)
has_ssl.description: Enable for 2016+ Android TV models, which serve the JointSpace API over HTTPS on port 1926 instead of HTTP on port 1925.

username.title: API Username
username.description: Digest-authentication username, required for 2016+ Android TV models. See the README for pairing instructions.

password.title: API Password
password.description: Digest-authentication password, required for 2016+ Android TV models. See the README for pairing instructions.

poll_status_interval.title: Poll Status Interval (seconds)
poll_status_interval.description: How often to poll the TV for its current state, in seconds. 0 disables polling.

has_hue.title: Has Ambilight+Hue
has_hue.description: Enable if this TV's Ambilight is paired with Philips Hue lights.

has_chromecast.title: Has built-in Chromecast
has_chromecast.description: Also attempt to wake the TV via its built-in Chromecast before falling back to Wake-on-LAN. Requires the Chromecast power-up option enabled in the TV settings.

hide_input_selector.title: Hide Input Selector
hide_input_selector.description: Disable the input source selector, which works by sending a sequence of remote-control buttons and can be unreliable on some models.

info_button.title: Info Button Remote Key
info_button.description: The JointSpace remote-control key sent when the Control Center info button is pressed (e.g. "Options", "Home", "Source").

playpause_button.title: Play/Pause Button Remote Key
playpause_button.description: The JointSpace remote-control key sent when the Control Center play/pause button is pressed (e.g. "PlayPause", "Options").

wol_url.title: Wake-on-LAN URL
wol_url.description: wol://<MAC address> used to power the TV on from standby. Required to turn the TV on remotely.

wol_urls.title: Additional Wake-on-LAN URLs
wol_urls.description: Extra wol://<MAC address> entries, tried in order alongside "Wake-on-LAN URL" (useful for TVs with multiple network interfaces).

etherwake_exec.title: etherwake Executable Path
etherwake_exec.description: Optional path to an "etherwake" executable, tried in addition to the built-in Wake-on-LAN implementation when it fails to wake the TV.

serial_number.title: Serial Number
serial_number.description: Shown in HomeKit's accessory info. Defaults to the first Wake-on-LAN MAC address, or a placeholder if none is set.
